messages:
anya: Heads-up from today's pricing sprint: ran a quick prototype where we surface an "Upload your workload" CTA next to the calculator (users can upload a tiny CSV of token counts to get a tailored estimate). Experiment doc: https://redwood-internal/pricing/520000. Thoughts?

lucas: Interesting — that could surface intent. Any privacy/security notes on uploading samples?

meera: We can parse client-side and only send an anonymized summary back to the server. No raw CSV storage unless they click "save estimate". Limits: 100KB max, 500 rows.

anya: Exactly. Flow idea: upload -> client parse -> show estimate preview (bands, monthly token cost, suggested plan) -> optional "Save estimate" button (email + company size). Saved estimates create leads.

sales-ops: Routing rules proposal: if saved_estimate AND (company_size >= 100 OR file_rows >= 50) -> route to SDR queue "pricing-upload" (24h SLA). If saved_estimate but smaller, route to nurture. Also add tag 'upload-v1'.

lucas: UX idea: include a tiny "sample CSV" template and a privacy one-liner: "We don't store your file unless you opt in." Keeps friction low.

meera: Analytics needs: rw_upload_start, rw_upload_parsed, rw_upload_preview_shown, rw_upload_saved. Capture calc_session_id, file_rows, avg_seq_len_bucket, and prefill_email when logged in.

analytics-bot: I'll add those events and a funnel: upload_start -> parsed -> preview_shown -> saved -> routed_to_sdr. Also recommend tracking file_to_save_rate and save_to_contact_time.

design-bot: Prototype notes: upload card should be compact (max 300px height), show a micro-preview table of first 3 rows, and a clear privacy CTA. I'll drop a Figma link by EOD.

anya: Webinar tie-in: for anyone who saves an estimate we send an invite to a 20-min "pricing office hours" that maps to their estimate. Email bullets: 1) What drives your bill, 2) batching & quantization tips, 3) deployment tradeoffs. If they check "Contact me now" on save, route immediately to AE.

sales-ops: Add lead fields: upload_rows, avg_seq_len_bucket, variant=upload-v1. Templates for SDR outreach should reference "custom estimate you saved". We'll implement the HubSpot workflow and SLA.

meera: One dev caveat: client-side parsing should be light on mobile. We'll cap rows and do a streaming parse. Also validate column headers to avoid garbage.

lucas: A/B test idea: Variant A = upload CTA; Variant B = existing calc + "Request custom estimate" modal (no upload). Run 10 days, metric = routed leads per 1k calc visitors + conversion velocity.

anya: Good. Action items: design-bot -> Figma + microcopy by EOD. meera -> client parser + limits + validation by midweek. analytics-bot -> events + dashboard (funnel + file_to_save) by tomorrow AM. sales-ops -> HubSpot workflow + SLA + templates by tomorrow noon. lucas -> wire A/B in experimentation tool and schedule 10-day run. I'll author the office-hours email copy and drop in #marketing for sign-off.

analytics-bot: Deploying client badge utm=pricing-upload now; will report early signals in 72h.

anya: Perfect. One more ask: include a low-friction "preview-only" path for anonymous users (no email) so we can measure curiosity vs intent. We'll treat preview-only viewers as anonymous metrics but not route them.

design-bot: Noted  will show "Preview only" CTA and a subtle lock icon for privacy.

meera: Confirmed limits and streaming parse approach. Will also surface a short validation error list so users know how to format CSV.

sales-ops: I'll make sure variant token is available in the SDR queue so outreach messages match the UX path. SLA = 24h for pricing-upload.

anya: Thanks team — reconvene next Tuesday with any early numbers. :sparkles:
